title: [YSQL] Statement taking too long corrupts current session
body:
When trying to use debugger and breakpoints in PG processing code I discovered this:
```sql
00:37 $ ./bin/ysqlsh
ysqlsh (11.2)
Type "help" for help.

postgres=# UPDATE t SET v = 2 WHERE id = 1;    -- Put a breakpoint in Tablet::KeyValueBatchFromPgsqlWriteBatch and stall the execution flow for say 10 seconds
ERROR:  Error during commit: Operation expired: Transaction expired
postgres=# UPDATE t SET v = 2 WHERE id = 1;
ERROR:  current transaction is aborted, commands ignored until end of transaction block
postgres=# UPDATE t SET v = 2 WHERE id = 1;
ERROR:  current transaction is aborted, commands ignored until end of transaction block
postgres=# ROLLBACK;
FATAL:  CleanupTransaction: unexpected state INPROGRESS
FATAL:  CleanupTransaction: unexpected state INPROGRESS
server closed the connection unexpectedly
	This probably means the server terminated abnormally
	before or while processing the request.
The connection to the server was lost. Attempting reset: Succeeded.
postgres=#
```
After that session becomes usable again.

However, there is no explicit transaction and thus there should be no `current transaction is aborted` when using `ysqlsh` like this.

On `yb-tserver` side, it causes `ybclient` to reinitialize:
